result:
Round 7 passes all six checks, with no bugs found. The real-app checks (single save and batch saves in the built app) ran, so `realVerified` is true.

**Evidence for each check:**
- **R7-1 (red/green):** On a copy that uses the old `metadata.ts` from `d52354d`, 2 tests fail and 11 pass. The failures are (a), whose promise resolved instead of rejecting, and (c), which returned `succeeded: 2, failed: []`. (b), (d) and `riff-info-nul` (a)–(i) pass. Case (i) is a pin test and passes on the old code too. On the real tree all 13 pass. I opened A's own red and green logs and they show the same results.
- **R7-2 (mutations):** Every mutation was caught:
  - M1 (old `if (infoTags.length > 0)` restored): (a) and (c) fail.
  - M2 (guard moved outside the custom-fields block): only (b) fails.
  - M3 (throw after `file.save()`): (a) and (c) fail.
  - M4 (one character of the message changed): (a) and (c) fail.
  - I added M2b (guard just before `save()`, ignoring whether there are custom fields): (b) fails.
- **R7-3 (gate):** From a clean state the full `verifyCommand` exits 0:
  - Biome: 0 errors, 9 warnings, none in `metadata.ts`. The old and new `metadata.ts` both lint clean.
  - Type checks pass.
  - Renderer 107/107, main 55/55, E2E 7/7. E2E with `--retries=0` also gives 7/7.
- **R7-4 (single save in the real app):** I set Category `DOORWood`, Keywords `door, slam` and Comment `heavy door`, then saved, and got the `Tags saved` toast.
  - The file's raw bytes have `ICAT` 8, `IKEY` 10 and `ICMT` 10 bytes, with no zero bytes.
  - ffprobe and music-metadata both read the same values.
  - After Rescan the row shows `Tagged`.
- **R7-5 (batch saves in the real app):**
  - Ctrl+click on two files, then Category `BATCHCat`, gives `Tags saved to 2 files`. Both files have `ICAT` = `BATCHCat`.
  - The runner is not root (uid 1001), so the read-only case could be tested. One `chmod 444` file plus one writable file gives `1 saved, 1 failed`. The read-only file's sha256 is unchanged, and the writable file has `ICAT=ROCat`.
- **R7-6 (frozen files and ownership):** Only the three owned paths changed. The `metadata.ts` diff is just the guard plus the loop moved one level in. The only comment line in the diff is the existing one, re-indented. There is no `any`, `@ts-*` or `biome-ignore`. The source hashes were the same at the start and end of my phase.

**Notes for B (not bugs):**
- With the guard placed before the title workaround (M2/M2b), test (d) and the recording-tag contract tests still pass. On a fresh `sample.wav`, which has no INFO chunk, the INFO tag already exists when the file is opened. So the title workaround may be unnecessary; this is a guess I haven't tested further.
- The task says `meta:writeBatch`, but the real channel is `meta:write-batch`. A's test uses the correct name.

**Process note:** one of my commands briefly created `src/main/ipc/__c_tmp_never.ts` (a copy of the old `metadata.ts`) and deleted it in the same command. The gate and the `--retries=0` E2E run had already finished by then. The final `git status` and source hashes are clean, and I've recorded this in the report.
